infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Health Staff Pros uses the camera to scan and upload employment documents such as licenses, certifications, ID cards, and I-9 verification forms required for your healthcare staffing employment.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Health Staff Pros needs access to your photo library to upload employment documents such as licenses, certifications, and I-9 verification forms.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Health Staff Pros uses your contacts to help you refer colleagues for healthcare staffing positions and earn referral bonuses.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Health Staff Pros syncs your work shifts to your calendar so you can easily track your scheduled healthcare assignments.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsWriteOnlyAccessUsageDescripti: Health Staff Pros adds your work shifts to your calendar so you can easily track your scheduled healthcare assignments.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Health Staff Pros uses Face ID for secure, quick login to protect your employment and patient data.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Health Staff Pros uses your location to verify clock-in/clock-out times at healthcare facility work sites.
